description: This file defines the AuthenticationService class, which handles user credential verification and setting user attributes within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for setting credentials, validating user status, and populating authentication user data.

classes.name: AuthenticationService
classes.description: Service class providing authentication-related functionalities for user credential validation and attribute setting within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setCredentialsForUser
methods.description: Validates the provided User object, checks if the user is active, not deleted, assigned, and not terminated. If valid, sets user attributes for authentication purposes.

methods.name: setCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves a User entity based on provided credentials and delegates to setCredentialsForUser for validation and setting.

methods.name: setUserAttributes
methods.description: Sets relevant user information into the authentication context, including user ID, role, employee number, and last modified date.
